goal: Подготовить самостоятельный содержательный разбор Dale Carnegie How to Stop Worrying and Start Living. Включить краткий обзор, десять частей конкретного изученного электронного текста, анализ, практические иллюстрации, ограничения и до восьми смысловых ответов; не копировать защищённый текст.

source_documents.locator: Official publisher page, Gallery Books paperback 2004, ISBN 9780671035976, 320 pages
facts: Publisher describes self-help advice on work, finances, sleep, gratitude and criticism, but claims of guaranteed benefit are marketing, not clinical evidence.
Different editions and translations may have different page numbers, titles, revisions and subdivisions.

facts: Publication year 1948 is attested bibliographically. Do not claim the checked web-text layout is identical to the 1948 copy.

source_documents.locator: Externally hosted full text; contents list ten parts and thirty main chapters plus 32 case stories; edition/rightsholder not established
facts: Part I: focus on the present day, handling a feared outcome, bodily effects of worry.
Part II: collect facts, analyze a problem, choose and act; work-related worries.
Part III: habit of worry, small irritations, likelihood, acceptance of what cannot be changed, limiting rumination over the past.
Part IV: attitude, resentment, gratitude, individuality and helping others; historical claims about curing melancholy are not modern medical evidence.
Part V: family/religious outlook as one personal route, not universal prescription.
Part VI: response to criticism; Part VII: fatigue, work habits and insomnia; Part VIII: vocational choice; Part IX: financial planning; Part X: personal case stories.
Use for research only. Do not copy passages, quotes or reconstruct substantial narrative sections; write independent summaries.

source_documents.locator: NIMH fact sheet on stress/anxiety and seeking help
facts: Worrying that persists or interferes with daily life warrants professional evaluation; self-help book does not diagnose or replace care.
